digest.component_or_area: probe rebar harness and CI integration
propositions: Shell probe harness accumulated 3 stale assertions against removed flags/keysets that must be enumerated and either ported or retired with justification.
Naive port or hardening pass would break the deliberate continue-on-failure design (no 'set -e'); Python port must preserve explicit collect-results, report-all, exit-nonzero-if-any-failed contract.

Workflow definition in gerrit-verify.yaml executes from main's tree against patchset code; a change deleting the shell probe cannot pass main's still-shell golden-path step without a transitional shim.
All enumerated consumers (workflows, anti-rot test, docs) must be re-pointed to Python entry point atomically in the same change to keep CI and anti-rot gate tracking the new harness.
Side-by-side parity run must show identical pass/fail verdicts before shell deletion; self-test with injected failure must confirm harness continues and exits non-zero.
